text: I led the migration of our payments service to microservices which cut our p99 latency significantly and reduced on call load for the team
I led the migration of our payments service to microservices which cut our p99 latency significantly and reduced on call load for the team
You said latency improved significantly — give me the actual number. What was p99 before and after the migration, and how did you measure it?
it went from around four hundred milliseconds down to about two hundred and twenty and we measured it with our existing tracing dashboards before and after rollout
it went from around four hundred milliseconds down to about two hundred and twenty and we measured it with our existing tracing dashboards before and after rollout
Roughly 45%. Was that rollout gradual or all at once — and what broke, if anything, during the cutover?
we rolled it out gradually behind a feature flag by traffic percentage and one downstream service briefly had a retry storm which we fixed with backoff
